name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine
benefit: > **Financial Assistance:** - Maximum grant of ₹1,00,00,000/- for one project for 18 months. - The funds will be released in two installments of 60% and 40% of the total amount sanctioned. The second installment will be released after receiving expenditure of at least 75% of the released amount and after acceptance of UC thereof.
_eligibility_text: - The AYUSH teaching Institutions and AYUSH hospitals can apply for the scheme. - The Institutions/ Organisations should be having collaboration with only recognized National and International sports bodies such as the Sports Authority of India, All India Football Federation, Indian Olympic Association, The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), International Cricket Council (ICC), etc.
